wire-format.why: handleSubmit calls model.save({displayName, website}), so the model's toJSON envelope and parse are still used.

validation.why: Validation stays in app.Profile (unchanged) and the form only calls model.save, so Backbone's validate runs and blocks the request; the 'invalid' event populates the .error span.

no-rollback.why: It uses model.save without wait:true, so Backbone's default semantics (attributes set before the server responds, no rollback) are kept.

header-sync.why: A model.on('change:displayName') listener calls updateHeaderName, which sets #header .name text.

saved-flash.why: The sync handler sets saved=true and a timer clears it after 1500ms, rendering a 'Saved' span with an opacity transition.

cleanup.why: The useEffect cleanup calls model.off for invalid, sync and change:displayName and clears the timer.
